newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said. Inquiry fair, demand light.

Sales confirmed for the week to date on 73,300 head including 16,600 head or about 23 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Thursday bids $66.00-$67.00 per cwt, asking $68.00-$69.00, last sales $68.00 on Wed, April 23. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. confirmed - none
